Why does everyone in the world pretend to support me and then turn to my mother behind my back? I want to send an email asking the dean why she would do this after being so supportive and sweet to me. Does she have any legal right to do this as I am an adult? Obviously this would not help me at this point since I just graduated, but it would be cathartic. WIBTA?
